leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement an async function using the async/await syntax
Construct a simple event loop to execute asynchronous tasks
Apply the asyncio library to manage concurrent operations
Configure multiple coroutines to run concurrently using asyncio.gather
Manipulate task execution order using asyncio.sleep for simulated delays
Integrate async functions with synchronous code using asyncio.run
Control the flow of asynchronous operations with asyncio.create_task
